strings.subtitle: — Muchisi wa tifayili —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ku koka ni ku tshika a swi kumeki. Tirhisa buti leyi nga ehansi.
strings.ft_lnk: Ndhawu yo koma (.lnk) — yi ta alela
strings.strategy_full_small_short: ☢  HI YO HETISEKA (fayili < 1 GB, yi tiyimela)
strings.strategy_fast: ⚡  HI KU HATLISA — milayini ya 4 MB
strings.strategy_full: ☢  HI YO HETISEKA — hinkwaswo hi zero (ntiyiseko)
strings.ssd_warning:
Xitiviso! Eka SSD, ndlela yo tsala ehenhla a yi tiyisisi ku chisa hikwalaho ka TRIM.
Nongonoko lowu i wa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fayili "{name}" yi ta tsariwa ehenhla ni ku susiwa.

Yisa emahlweni?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
A ndzi swi koti ku hlaya fayili:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAYILI YI TSARIWILE EHENHLA NI KU SUSIWA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mindzilekano yin'wana ya data (ADS) a yi tirhi.
• Buku ra USN a ri basisiwi.
• Tikhophi ta nsinya ni ku hlanganyeta ka mapapa
  (OneDrive ni swin'wana) a swi khumbeki.
strings.status_full: Leswi nga endzeni swi tsariwile ehenhla hi zero hinkwaswo. Ku tlherisela a swi koteki — switirhisiwa swi ta vona zero ntsena.
strings.status_fast: Nhloko, mongo ni milayini ya 4 MB swi tsariwile ehenhla. Leswi saleke a swi khumbekanga, kambe hikwalaho ka minkhawa, ku tlherisela hinkwaswo hi switirhisiwa swa mutirhisi a swi koteki. Eka mapapila ya xihundla tirhisa MODE HI YO HETISEKA.
strings.status_empty: Fayili a yi ri hava nkoko, ku tsala ehenhla a swi laveki. Yi susiwile.
strings.error_permission: A ndzi koti ku fikelela fayili. Yi nga va yi pfarile eka nongonoko wun'wana. Yi pfala ni ku ringeta nakambe.
strings.error_not_found: Fayili a yi kumekanga. Yi nga va yi susiwile.
strings.error_is_symlink: Leri i xihlanganisi xa xifaniso. Swihlanganisi a swi koteki ku chisiwa — fayili yo kongomisa yi ta tshama yi ri kahle.
strings.error_reparse: Leri i fayili ya ndhawu (OneDrive kumbe swo fana). Data ya yona yi le mapapeni, a yi ri eka diski — laha a ku na nchumu wo chisa.
strings.error_not_file: Leri a hi fayili (foldara kumbe swin'wana). Tshika fayili.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fayili leyi yi na swihlanganisi swin'wana swa matimba ({n} hinkwaswo). Swihlanganisi swa matimba a swi na lonkulu — mavito hinkwawo ma ringana. Loko u chisa hi ndlela ya sweswi, data yi ta tsariwa ehenhla ni ku tsemiwa eka 32 byte, kambe leswi saleke swi ta tshama swi fikeleriwa hi swihlanganisi swin'wana. Chisa swihlanganisi hinkwaswo ku sungula.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayili yi pfunetiwe, yi hlawulekisiwile kumbe yi lehe. Ku tsala ehenhla hi zero a swi tiyisisi ku chisiwa ka data ya khale hikuva NTFS yi yi hlayisa hi ndlela yin'wana.

Susa xikombiso: klika exineni → Swikombiso → Ehenhla → susa xikombiso eka "Pfuna" ni/kumbe "Hlawulekisa". Endzhaku tirhisa SHREDDER nakambe.
